statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: app/components/ui/input-otp.tsx, app/components/ui/**/*.test.tsx, tests/**. Do not edit forbidden paths: app/routes/**, app/**/server*, prisma/**, .env*, package.json, package-lock.json.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.

review.notes: Approved: component:InputOTP uniquely selects the production reusable control and returns limited as declared. Tailwind authority is established by app/styles/tailwind.css, candidate scope text is exact, and the rank-one guard now excludes test, generated, and build output.
